- **MVT 201 — Dual-Path Regression Suite (Direct 201 vs Reservation → 201) (Item 15) (2026-10-19, 09:55 IST):** Complete.
  - **Item 15 (Regression-test both 201 paths: Direct 201 and Reservation → 201):**
    - Implemented dedicated, comprehensive dual-path regression suite in `test/unit/wm/goodsIssue201DualPaths.test.js` (24 tests) proving side-by-side agreement across all 8 required dimensions:
      1. **Authorization:**
         - Both reject unauthenticated / unauthorized requests (`Viewer` role) with HTTP 403.
         - Both permit authorized warehouse roles (`WarehouseClerk`, `WarehouseManager`, `Admin`).
      2. **Cost Center:**
         - Mandatory for both paths; validated as 1–10 alphanumeric characters.
         - Padded to 10 digits for SAP S/4HANA (e.g., `0001011201` / `1011201301`).
         - Reservation path reconciles payload `CostCenter` against authoritative reservation header `CostCenter` (from `C_ReservationDocTP_F4839`), rejecting mismatches with HTTP 400.
         - Populates reservation header CostCenter when omitted from client payload.
      3. **Batch:**
         - Uppercase normalization (`in26001170` → `IN26001170`) across both paths.
         - Validates batch against unrestricted stock in plant/storage location.
         - Reservation path rejects mismatched batch when reservation is batch-pinned.
      4. **Serial Number:**
         - Strict 1:1 serial number mapping to `IssueQty` across both paths.
         - Rejects serial count / quantity mismatches with HTTP 400 before SAP dispatch.
         - Added `serialCountCheck` to `postGoodsIssue201` handler, eliminating parity divergence with direct 201 and 301/311.
      5. **Stock Pre-check:**
         - Both paths execute pre-check stock revalidation before SAP dispatch.
         - Both fail-closed with HTTP 422 if stock is deficient in plant/SLoc/batch.
      6. **Quantity:**
         - Both reject non-positive or non-numeric quantities (`<= 0`, `NaN`, `Infinity`) with HTTP 400.
         - Reservation path enforces open quantity ceiling (`RequiredQty - WithdrawnQty`), rejecting over-issue with HTTP 422.
         - Reservation path rejects deleted (`IsMarkedForDeletion`) or completed (`ReservationIsFinallyIssued`) items with HTTP 422.
      7. **Idempotency & Replay Protection:**
         - Both paths register atomic idempotency attempt in `GoodsIssueAttemptStore` (`createOrGet`).
         - Both reject concurrent in-flight submissions on the same idempotency key with HTTP 409 (`already in progress`).
         - Both record `unconfirmed` status on network timeout/HTTP 504 to prevent blind duplicate retries.
      8. **SAP Posting Result:**
         - Both post standardized deep insert payload to `API_MATERIAL_DOCUMENT_SRV/A_MaterialDocumentHeader`:
           - `GoodsMovementCode = '03'` (Goods Issue).
           - `GoodsMovementType = '201'`.
           - Padded 10-digit `CostCenter` on item.
           - Reservation path includes `Reservation` and `ReservationItem`.
         - Both return standardized Material Document response (`MaterialDocument`, `MaterialDocYear`, `Status: 'posted'`).

       - Batch-managed materials (e.g. `1000000928`) failed backend preflight with `"Batch is mandatory for batch-managed material..."` because `ReservationEntryDetail.view.xml` lacked a Batch input field.

Updated i18n bundle with `resFieldBatch` and `resPlaceholderBatch`. Added `Batch: ""` to defaults in `ReservationEntryDetail.controller.js` and wired `_handleValueHelpSelected` for `inputBatch`.
    2. **Movement 261 (Goods Issue to Order) Restriction to Internal Orders Only:**
       - `OrderTypeVH` in CAP previously restricted orders strictly to `AUTYP = '01'` (Internal Orders only), which blocked Process Orders (`ZP01`, e.g. order `1002790`) and Production Orders (`PP01`). Selecting order `1002790` triggered an Order Type mismatch error against default `ZEMP`.
       - Expanded `OrderTypeVH` on `T003O` to query all goods-issue relevant categories (`01` Internal, `10` Production, `40` Process, `30` Maintenance). Added fallback types `ZP01`, `PP01`, `PM01`.
       - Updated `InternalOrderVH` to support plant filtering and querying without restricting strictly to `AUTYP = '01'`, and added `1002790` (`ZP01`) to fallback list.
       - In `ReservationEntryDetail.controller.js`, selecting an order now automatically syncs and updates `OrderType` if present on the selected order object. Updated field label `lblInternalOrder` to `{i18n>resFieldOrder}`.
    3. **Movement 301 (Plant-to-Plant Transfer) Inverted Field Hierarchy & Missing Display:**
       - In `ReservationEntryDetail.view.xml`, Receiving Storage Location was rendered before Receiving Plant, inverting the standard SAP hierarchy (Plant determines available SLocs).
       - Reordered XML view layout so Receiving Plant (`inputRecPlant`) appears before Receiving Storage Location (`inputRecSLoc`).
       - Extended display visibility of `ReceivingStorageLocation` in `formReservationDisplay` to include Movement 301 (`detail>/MovementType === '301'`).
    4. **Movement 311 (SLoc-to-SLoc Transfer) Default Destination SLoc Collision:**
       - When the issuing storage location was set to `ST02`, switching to or triggering Movement 311 previously assigned `ReceivingStorageLocation` to `ST02`, causing identical SLocs and immediate client/server validation failure.
       - Implemented collision avoidance in `onMovementTypeChange` and `_handleValueHelpSelected`: if issuing SLoc is `ST02`, default receiving SLoc to `CS01`; otherwise default to `ST02`.
    5. **Movement 201 (Goods Issue to Cost Center) Missing Value Help:**
       - Cost Center input field was plain text with no value help or suggestions, requiring manual entry of the 10-digit number.
       - Added `@readonly entity CostCenterVH` to `srv/wm/reservation-entry/service.cds` with `CostCenter`, `CostCenterName`, and `CompanyCode`.

- **WM Movement 261: Unified Stock Availability Calculation Across Scan, Open-Item List, and Posting Gate (Issue #1 in Critical / High Issues) (2026-10-17, 10:50 IST):** Complete.
  - **User Problem & Incident:**
    - Movement 261: "Scan/List/Post calculate available stock differently. The open-item list can say an item is ready while the scan context says there is no issuable stock at the required location." (Severity: High).
  - **Root Cause & Architectural Discovery:**
    1. In `srv/integration/s4hana/wm/Mvt261Adapter.js`, `_issuable(ctx, quants, locationStock)` evaluated stock warehouse-wide for WM reservations (`q.LGNUM === ctx.warehouse`) without checking whether quants were located in the reservation's issue storage location (`RESB-LGORT`) or production supply area (`PVBE-LGORT`). Quants located in unrelated storage locations of the warehouse (e.g. `ZZ99`) were incorrectly included in `issuableQty` and `issuableUnits`.
    2. In contrast, `scanContext()` strictly filtered storage units by `locations = [c.StorageLocation, c.SupplyAreaStorageLocation]`, excluding any storage units in other storage locations of the warehouse.
    3. As a result, `openItems` reported an item as ready (`ScanPossible: true, ReadyStorageUnits: >0, ReadyQuantity: >0`), but opening the scan page showed `Blocked: true` with 0 available storage units, and attempting to post failed with 422.
    4. In `_reservationFacts()`, SQL filtering `AND XLOEK = '' AND KZEAR = ''` risked dropping valid un-deleted reservation rows when SAP stored space characters (`' '`), and in `_nonWmStock()`, alphanumeric material IDs were incorrectly padded with leading zeroes.
  - **Changes Implemented Across Stack:**
    1. **Unified Issuable Stock Definition (`srv/integration/s4hana/wm/Mvt261Adapter.js`):**
       - Updated `_issuable(ctx, quants, locationStock)`:
         - Defines `locations = [...new Set([ctx.storageLocation, ctx.supplyAreaStorageLocation].filter(Boolean))]`.
         - Ready quants filter enforces: `q.LGNUM === ctx.warehouse && (!q.LGORT || !locations.length || locations.includes(q.LGORT)) && batchOk(q.CHARG) && !this._quantNotReady(q)`.
         - Permitted interim quants without explicit `LGORT` while strictly excluding unrelated storage locations within the warehouse.
         - Enforces `!this._quantNotReady(q)` on supply-area stock.
         - Updated reason message to report batch name when reservation specifies a pinned batch: `no unrestricted stock in ${ctx.storageLocation || 'the issue location'}${ctx.batch ? ' for batch ' + ctx.batch : ''}`.
    2. **Scan Context Alignment (`srv/integration/s4hana/wm/Mvt261Adapter.js`):**
       - Updated `here` filter in `scanContext()` to match `_issuable()`: `(!q.LGORT || !locations.length || locations.includes(q.LGORT))`.
    3. **Robust Data Extraction (`srv/integration/s4hana/wm/Mvt261Adapter.js`):**
       - In `_reservationFacts()`: Replaced SQL deletion check with in-memory check `if (r.XLOEK !== 'X' && r.KZEAR !== 'X')`.
       - In `_nonWmStock()`: Zero-pads only numeric material numbers (`/^\d+$/.test(i.Material) ? i.Material.padStart(18, '0') : i.Material`).
    4. **Comprehensive Unit Tests (`test/unit/wm/mvt261Adapter.test.js` & `test/unit/wm/mvt261Scan.test.js`):**
       - Added test suite `Mvt261 unified stock availability calculation across Scan, List, and Post` in `mvt261Adapter.test.js`:
         - Unrelated warehouse storage location (`ZZ99`): `openItems`, `scanContext`, and `postGoodsIssue` all agree on `Blocked: true` (0 ready storage units, 0 ready qty, 422 rejection on post).
         - Matching warehouse storage location (`CS01`): `openItems`, `scanContext`, and `postGoodsIssue` all agree on `ScanPossible: true` (2 ready storage units, 200 KG, successful posting).
         - Pinned batch with stock only in another batch: `openItems`, `scanContext`, and `postGoodsIssue` all agree on `Blocked: true` citing the pinned batch.
       - Updated `test/unit/wm/mvt261Scan.test.js` test mocks and fixtures to accurately simulate warehouse storage location mapping (`T320`) and RESB queries by plant.
  - **Quality & Regression Results:**
    - Full 261 test suite (`npx jest test/unit/wm/*261*`): **7 test suites passed, 158 tests passed, 0 failures (100% green)**.
    - Full WM test suite (`npx jest test/unit/wm`): **78 test suites passed, 1859 tests passed, 0 failures (100% green)**.
    - Full repo test suite (`npm test`): **168 test suites passed, 3125 tests passed, 0 failures (100% green)**.

- **WM Warehouse Scan-To & Reservation: Support Non-WM Receiving Storage Locations for Movement 311 & TR 0001001912 Resolution (2026-10-17, 10:15 IST):** Complete.
  - **User Problem & Incident:**
    - Error on `/wm/scan-to/W12/TR/0001001912`:
      `"Failed to create reservation: Receiving storage location MT01 is not assigned to warehouse in plant 1130 (T320)"`
      `"Receiving Storage Location MT01 in plant 1130 is not assigned to warehouse W12 (T320)"`
  - **Root Cause & SAP Architectural Discovery:**
    1. **Table T320 Mapping:** In SAP table `T320`, Plant `1130` maps Warehouse `W12` to 10 storage locations (`CS01, CS02, FG01, HS01, HS02, IP01, OH01, OH02, PWIP, RJ02`).
    2. **Storage Location MT01 Status:** Storage location `MT01` (Maintenance Team - 2) is defined in Plant `1130` in `T001L` and extended in `MARD` for material `8000009822`, but it is an Inventory Management (IM-only / non-WM) storage location without an entry in `T320`.
    3. **Standard SAP Capability:** In standard SAP S/4HANA (Client 220), transfer posting 311 from a WM warehouse (`W12 / HS01`) to an IM-only non-WM storage location (`MT01`) is standard business functionality. Live SAP RFC calls proved that `BAPI_RESERVATION_CREATE1`, `BAPI_GOODSMVT_CREATE`, and `Z_WM_TO_CREATE_FROM_TR` all succeed without requiring the receiving storage location to be in `T320`.
    4. **Application Restriction:** Previously, custom application code in `ReservationProcessAdapter.js` and `TrToAdapter.js` strictly required that receiving storage location must be in `T320`, falsely rejecting valid Non-WM destination storage locations.
  - **Changes Implemented Across Stack:**
    1. **Reservation & MIGO Adapter (`srv/integration/s4hana/wm/ReservationProcessAdapter.js`):**
       - In `createReservation`: Validates issuing SLoc in `T320` (`t320Iss` must exist). For Movement 311 `receivingStorageLocation`, checks `T320`: if mapped to a different warehouse than the issuing warehouse, rejects with 400 (cross-warehouse transfer not supported in 311); if not mapped in `T320`, permits as a valid Non-WM storage location (verified in `MARD`/`T001L`).
       - In `postGoodsMovement`: For Movement 311, checks `T320` for `sRecSLoc`: if mapped to a different warehouse than `sSLoc`, rejects with 400; if unmapped in `T320`, permits as Non-WM storage location.
    2. **Transfer Order Adapter (`srv/integration/s4hana/wm/TrToAdapter.js`):**
       - In `createTOFromTR`: For Movement 311 `finalRecSLoc`, checks `T320`: if mapped, ensures its warehouse matches `wh`; if not mapped in `T320`, permits as Non-WM storage location (verified in `T001L`).
    3. **UI Consistency (`app/fiori-app/webapp/modules/wm/warehouse-scan-to/view/WarehouseScanTo.view.xml`):**
       - Removed `title="{i18n>scanToPageTitle}"` attribute from `<Page>` to adhere strictly to the project rule that the ShellBar owns page titles and back navigation.
    4. **Unit Test Updates (`test/unit/wm/`):**
       - `test/unit/wm/trToAdapter.test.js`: Updated cross-warehouse rejection test and added test verifying acceptance of Non-WM receiving storage location (64/64 passed).
       - `test/unit/wm/step19Mvt311.test.js`: Updated cross-warehouse rejection test and added test verifying acceptance of Non-WM receiving storage location (17/17 passed).
       - `test/unit/wm/mvt311Process.test.js`: Updated cross-warehouse rejection test and added test verifying acceptance of Non-WM receiving storage location (39/39 passed).
       - `test/unit/controller/uiConsistency.test.js`: Verified ShellBar title ownership and UI consistency rules (7/7 passed).

- **Storage Type Search Customizing Error (T334T / L3 007) on TR 0001000860: Root Cause, SAP SPRO Remediation & UI Stock Deficit Safeguard (2026-10-16, 16:10 IST):** Complete.
  - **User Problem & Symptom:**
    - On `http://localhost:4004/saps4hana-fiori-app/index.html#/wm/scan-to/TR/0001000860`, clicking "Create & Confirm TO" fails with:
      `Data for storage type search is not defined in warehouse W01 for WM movement type 311: missing customizing key in table T334T (Warehouse: W01, Operation: A [Stock Removal], Storage Type Indicator: 'EN1'). Maintain search sequence in SPRO: Logistics Execution > Warehouse Management > Strategies > Stock Removal Strategies > Determine Storage Type Search.`
  - **Root Cause Confirmed via Live SAP S/4HANA (Client 220) Inspection:**
    1. **Missing Customizing Key in `T334T`:** Direct table read of `T334T` confirms Warehouse `W01` defines stock placement / putaway (`KZEAR = 'E'`) entries for indicator `EN1` (`W01/E/EN1 -> EN1, 003`), but stock removal (`KZEAR = 'A'`) ONLY contains rows for blank (`***`) and `005`. The key `(LGNUM = 'W01', KZEAR = 'A', LGTKZ = 'EN1')` is missing from S/4HANA customizing table `T334T`.
    2. **Material Master WM Indicator (`MLGN`):** Material `8000009753` (Apple Macbook Pro 14", M5) in Warehouse `W01` has stock removal indicator `MLGN-LTKZA = 'EN1'`.
    3. **Physical Inventory Deficit in `HS01` (`LQUA` vs `MARD`):** TR `0001000860` was created for Material `8000009753`, Plant `1120`, Storage Location `HS01`. In `LQUA`, Storage Location `HS01` has **ZERO** physical stock in warehouse `W01` (it only contains 2.000 NOS sitting in interim transfer storage type `921 / TRANSFER`, which cannot be used as a pick source). The actual physical stock for `8000009753` in Warehouse `W01` resides in Storage Location `MT01` (3 NOS in Storage Type `EN1`, Bin `0-L0001-01`).
    4. **Trigger Chain:** Because `HS01` has no physical stock in `LQUA`, `lookupTR` could not determine a physical source storage type and bin (`SourceStorageType: ""`, `SourceStorageBin: ""`). When "Create & Confirm TO" was clicked, blank source bin parameters were sent to SAP. Standard SAP function module `L_TO_CREATE_TR` then executed automatic stock removal search: `T334T_LESEN(W01, A, EN1)`, failing with `L3 007` because of the missing customizing entry in `T334T`.
  - **Fixes Delivered:**
    1. **Frontend Validation Safeguard (`WarehouseScanToDetail.controller.js`):** In `_validateForm()`, added a stock deficit gate: when `oTR.StockWarning` is present and `!sourceStorageBin`, it blocks submission (`canSubmit = false`), updates the status badge to `STOCK DEFICIT` (state: `Error`), and prevents submitting guaranteed-to-fail requests to SAP.
    2. **UI Test Suite (`test/unit/wm/warehouseScanToUi.test.js`):** Added comprehensive test verifying that stock deficits with unresolved source bins block submission and display `STOCK DEFICIT` error state (54/54 passed).
  - **Remediation for SAP Administrator / Operator:**
    - **SPRO Customizing Maintenance (SAP GUI):**
      - Transaction: `SPRO`
      - Path: `Logistics Execution > Warehouse Management > Strategies > Stock Removal Strategies > Determine Storage Type Search`
      - Table: `T334T`
      - Maintain entry: Warehouse `W01`, Operation `A` (Stock Removal), Storage Type Indicator `EN1`, Search Sequence `EN1`, `001`, `***`.
    - **Inventory Operational Path:**
      - Material `8000009753` has 3 NOS of physical stock in Storage Location `MT01` (`EN1 / 0-L0001-01`).
      - Operators should create reservations specifying issuing storage location `MT01` (where physical stock resides) or perform a stock transfer from `MT01` to `HS01`.
      - For movement testing with existing customizing, materials with blank removal indicator (`LTKZA = ''`), such as `8900000004` or `8900000007` (in `CS01`), use `T334T` search rule `***` and process immediately.

- **Final Code-Quality + Architecture Audit (14 Dimensions) (2026-10-15, 13:20 IST):** Complete. Executed a comprehensive final code-quality and architecture audit covering all 14 requested dimensions across CAP backend services, S/4HANA RFC/OData adapters, and SAPUI5/Fiori frontend modules.
  - **14 Audit Dimensions Evaluated & Verified:**
    1. **Duplicate SAP Posting Risks:** Resolved & Protected. Enforced three-tier idempotency in `ReservationProcessAdapter.js` (`checkMigoIdempotency`, `buildMigoBusinessKey`). Pre-posting checks query: (a) caller pre-posted material document, (b) persistent CAP database (`ZRES_TRACK` with `rsnum:item:mvt:tanum:qty`), (c) SAP `MATDOC` transparent table (`SGTXT = processId` and `RSNUM/RSPOS` with `CANCELLED = ''`). Repeat submissions return existing `MATDOC` with `alreadyPosted: true` and 0 duplicate BAPI calls. Completed TRs (`STATU = E`) are blocked in scan and detail views.
    2. **Race Conditions:** Resolved & Protected. Database row-level locking (`SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` via `lockTrack` in `trTo.handler.js` and `lockEntry` in `service.js`) serializes concurrent requests for the same reservation/track. Dynamic SAP reservation lock (`withReservationLock`) protects in-flight SAP transactions. UI buttons bind to `view>/busy` and `processing` guards to block rapid multi-clicks.
    3. **Transaction Consistency:** Resolved & Protected. BAPI calls run within a single SAP LUW (`rfc.session()`) followed by `BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT` with `WAIT: 'X'`. Uncommitted LUWs rollback automatically or via `BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK`. Dependency pipeline is strictly sequential: `Reservation → TR → Scan → TO → Confirm → MIGO`. Upstream failure halts downstream execution immediately (0 subsequent BAPIs called).
    4. **Error Recovery:** Resolved & Protected. Implemented granular step recovery via `retryStep` action. Unimported GUI reservations are auto-imported from SAP `RKPF`/`RESB`. Failed step is auto-detected from `Status_code` (`STATUS.TR_ERROR` → `LB01`, `STATUS.TO_ERROR` → `LT04`, `STATUS.TO_CONFIRM_ERROR` → `LT12`, `STATUS.GI_ERROR` → `MIGO`) allowing independent resumption without repeating successful steps.
    5. **Dead Code:** Cleaned & Eliminated. Fixed 5 fatal runtime `no-const-assign` errors in `srv/wm/tr-to/handlers/trTo.handler.js` where fallback resolution reassigned `const` variables. Removed unused `PROCESS_STATUS`, `ERROR_STATUSES`, `sapKeyOpt`, `MOVEMENT_CONFIG`, and dead variable assignments across `service.js`, `trTo.handler.js`, and `ReservationProcessAdapter.js`.
    6. **Hardcoded SAP Values:** Sanitized & Externalized. Dynamic plant-to-warehouse mapping (`T320`), movement parameters (`T333`), and storage location stock (`MARD`) are queried live from SAP tables. Client and destination configurations are strictly read via `s4Config.js` (`cds.env.s4`, `S4_DESTINATION_URL`, `S4_CLIENT`, etc.) without hardcoded SAP client or tenant literals.
    7. **Environment/Configuration Leaks:** Cleaned & Secured. No passwords, client secrets, API keys, or private certificates are committed in Git. `.env` and `.env.*` are excluded by `.gitignore`. Local mock logins are strictly disabled in production environments (`auth-service.js`), enforcing SAP BTP XSUAA SSO.
    8. **Security Issues:** Hardened & Verified. Strict trust boundaries: movement types are whitelist-validated (`['201', '241', '301', '311']`); unsupported types (e.g. 261) fail closed immediately before touching DB or SAP. All database queries use CDS parameterized SQL (`SELECT.where()`). All RFC table queries use sanitized/padded alphanumeric keys (`sapKey`, `alphaIn`). CSRF tokens are fetched and verified on state-changing requests.
    9. **Performance Problems:** Optimized. RFC table queries specify explicit projection arrays (`readTable(..., ['MATNR', 'WERKS', ...])`) rather than reading full structures. CAP OData views use focused `$select` projections. UI5 tables employ client-side pagination / growing lists (`growing="true"`). Re-rendering churn is minimized by updating two-way bound JSON model properties.
    10. **Logging & Audit Issues:** Structured & Complete. Implemented structured audit trail in `saps4hana.wm.ReservationTrack` and `saps4hana.wm.ReservationLog`, mirroring SAP `ZRES_TRACK` and `ZRES_LOG` with SLG1 Application Log handles (`BALLOGHNDL`, `BALEXTN`, `BALSUBOBJ`, `ProcessId`, `DocumentNo`). Posting attempts pre-persist in `GoodsIssuePostingAttempt` before S/4HANA is called.
    11. **Unused Imports / Functions:** Pruned & Validated. Cleaned 8 ESLint warnings in `TrToAdapter.js`, `GoodsIssuePostingClient.js`, and `GoodsIssueStockUnitClient.js`. `npx eslint srv/` passes with 0 errors and 0 warnings. `npx eslint test/e2e/wm/` passes with 0 errors and 0 warnings. `ui5lint` passes with 0 findings.
    12. **UI Memory Leaks:** Cleaned & Verified. Controller `onExit` lifecycle hooks cleanly detach barcode hardware scanners (`BarcodeScanService.detachHardwareScanner`) and destroy reusable dialog instances (`_oTrSelectDialog.destroy()`). Models and routers are scoped to controller/view lifecycle.
    13. **OData Error Handling:** Standardized & Semantically Classified. `S4ErrorMapper.js` parses OData V2 JSON errors, inner error details, embedded JSON, and XML Gateway dumps. Maps SAP business and technical errors to standard HTTP status codes (400 for input format/closed posting period `M7053`, 401/403 for auth/CSRF, 404 for missing resource, 409 for locks/concurrency, 422 for business rules, 502/503 for network/Gateway unavailability).
    14. **Production Readiness:** Validated & Ready. MTA deployment descriptor validated clean (`npx mbt validate -x paths`). CDS models compile clean (`npx cds compile srv/`). Full unit test regression passes 100% (76 test suites, 1,789 tests passed). UI5 linter passes with 0 findings.

- **Scan-TO (`/wm/scan-to`) `autoConfirm` & `autoPostMigo` End-to-End Diagnosis, Fix & Test Matrix (2026-10-13, 09:50 IST):**
  - **User Request:** Trace `autoConfirm` and `autoPostMigo` end-to-end on `/wm/scan-to/TR/{number}`, identify root cause, implement minimal fix, and add 4-case test matrix (`autoConfirm` on/off × `autoPostMigo` on/off).
  - **Diagnosis & End-to-End Trace:**
    - XML switch binding: `Switch id="switchAutoConfirm" state="{scanView>/autoConfirm}"` (lines 17-23) and `Switch id="switchAutoMigo" state="{scanView>/autoPostMigo}"` (lines 24-31) in `WarehouseScanToDetail.view.xml`.
    - Controller state & payload: Initialized to `autoConfirm: true`, `autoPostMigo: true` in `_getInitialState()`; event handlers `onAutoConfirmChange` and `onAutoMigoChange` update the `scanView` JSONModel. In `onProcessTO`, boolean values are read via `getProperty` and passed in `oPayload.autoConfirm` and `oPayload.autoPostMigo`.
    - Service payload & OData: `WarehouseScanToService.createTOFromTR(oPayload)` posts payload via `ODataClient.post` to `/odata/v4/tr-to/createTOFromTR`, where CAP deserializes `autoConfirm` and `autoPostMigo` as native booleans.
    - Handler & Adapter: Handler receives `req.data` and delegates to `adapter.createTOFromTR(data)`. In adapter, `autoConfirm` controls calling `confirmTO` (`L_TO_CONFIRM`). If `autoConfirm: true` succeeds, status is `'04'` (`TO_CONFIRMED`) and `Confirmed: true`. If `autoConfirm: false`, `confirmTO` is skipped, status is `'03'` (`TO_CREATED`), and `Confirmed: false`. If `confirmTO` fails, status is `'13'` (`TO_CONFIRM_ERROR`) and `Confirmed: false`.
    - Auto MIGO Gate in Handler: Previously, line 264 guarded MIGO auto-posting only with `if (data.autoPostMigo && result.Confirmed)`. If `autoConfirm` was turned off (`false`), but a TO was already confirmed or confirmed on retry, MIGO could fire unintentionally.
  - **Root Causes:**
    - `autoConfirm`: In `trTo.handler.js`, MIGO triggering did not explicitly assert `data.autoConfirm !== false`, relying solely on downstream `result.Confirmed`.
    - `autoPostMigo`: In `trTo.handler.js`, line 264 lacked the explicit guard that `data.autoConfirm !== false`, meaning MIGO was not strictly coupled to `autoConfirm` being enabled.
  - **Remediation Delivered (Minimal Diff):**
    - `srv/wm/tr-to/handlers/trTo.handler.js` line 264: Hardened condition to `if (data.autoConfirm !== false && data.autoPostMigo && result.Confirmed)`, strictly preventing MIGO from firing when `autoConfirm` is off.
    - `test/unit/wm/createTOFromTR.test.js`: Added 4 adapter-level tests covering the full 2×2 flag matrix.
    - `test/unit/wm/trToHandler.test.js`: Added 4 handler-level tests verifying MIGO trigger / suppression across all 4 combinations.
  - **Validation & Test Results:**
    - Full WM suite: `npx jest test/unit/wm/`: **65/65 test suites PASS, 1,371/1,371 tests PASS** (including the 8 new tests).
    - `npx cds compile srv --to sql`: Clean (0 errors).
    - `git diff --check`: Clean (0 errors).

    1. **Missing Customizing Key in `T334T`:** Direct table query of `T334T` via RFC confirms Warehouse `W01` has stock placement (`KZEAR = 'E'`) entries for `EN1`, `001`, `005`, `FG1`, `GS1`, `OH1`, `RM1`, but stock removal (`KZEAR = 'A'`) ONLY contains entries for blank (`***`) and `005`. There is NO entry for `(W01, A, EN1)`.
    2. **Physical Stock Distribution in `LQUA`:** Material `8000006485` has `MLGN-LTKZA = 'EN1'`. In `LQUA`, physical stock (2 NOS in `OH1` / `ONHOLD`) belongs to storage location `CS02`. Storage location `HS01` has ZERO positive physical quants (only interim `921 TRANSFER` and `902` interim negative).
    3. **Operational Cause:** When a reservation is created with Issuing SLoc `HS01` (e.g. `0000527594`), `lookupTR` cannot derive a physical source bin from `LQUA`. When creating the TO without an explicit source bin, SAP invokes the automatic search strategy `T334T_LESEN(W01, A, EN1)`, failing with `L3 007`. Conversely, when creating a reservation with Issuing SLoc `CS02`, physical stock is resolved in `OH1` / `ONHOLD`, bypassing the `T334T` lookup.
    4. **Error Masking Bug in `ReservationProcessAdapter.js`:** When `L_TO_CREATE_TR` failed with `Data for storage type search is not defined`, `ReservationProcessAdapter.js` previously caught the error and fell back to legacy wrapper `ZWM_TO_CREATE_FROM_TR`. Because `ZWM_TO_CREATE_FROM_TR` hardcodes `i_squit = 'X'`, SAP threw `squit_forbidden` (`Movement type 000 does not allow immediate confirmation`), obscuring the real customizing issue.
  - **Remediation Delivered:**
    1. `srv/integration/s4hana/wm/toState.js`: Added and exported `mapStorageTypeSearchError` converting SAP error `L3 007` into an actionable description specifying the exact missing key in `T334T` and the exact SPRO path.
    2. `srv/integration/s4hana/wm/ReservationProcessAdapter.js`: Updated `createTransferOrderFromTR` to intercept `Data for storage type search is not defined` and format it with `mapStorageTypeSearchError` instead of falling back to legacy wrappers.
    3. `srv/wm/reservation-entry/service.js`: Passed `movementType: track.MovementType` to `createTransferOrderFromTR` to ensure accurate movement type reporting in errors.
    4. `test/unit/wm/reservationProcess.test.js`: Added unit test verifying `L3 007` storage type search error mapping in `createTransferOrderFromTR` (22/22 PASS).
    5. Live SAP Verification: Verified live curl `retryStep(Step='LT04')` for reservation `0000527594` captures and records the exact SPRO message in `ReservationEntries.ErrorMessage` and `ReservationLogs`.
  - **Validation & Test Results:**

    - `npx cds compile srv --to sql`: Clean (0 errors).

    - Maintain entry:
      - Warehouse: `W01`

      - Storage Type Indicator: `EN1`

- **SAP GUI-Created Reservation (0000527594) Retrieval, Auto-Import & Padded Search Fix (2026-10-13, 09:20 IST):**
  - **User Request:** "Not get entri from when create from the GUI : 0000527594 Check Debug and Fix"
  - **Diagnose & Root Cause:**
    1. **Single Entity Read Missing Custom SAP Fallback:** `ReservationEntryService.ReservationEntries` is backed by `ReservationTrack` in local CDS SQLite/HANA persistence. Reservations created directly in SAP GUI (transaction `MB21`) exist in SAP tables `RKPF`/`RESB` but were not automatically seeded into `ReservationTrack`. Calling `GET /odata/v4/reservation-entry/ReservationEntries(ReservationNo='0000527594',ReservationItem='0001')` or `(ReservationNo='527594',ReservationItem='0001')` returned HTTP 404 because CAP default READ handler had no record in `ReservationTrack`.
    2. **Padded vs. Unpadded Number Mismatch:** In `ReservationEntryList.controller.js`, the search filter performed strict `includes(sQuery)`. When an operator searched using SAP GUI's 10-digit number (`0000527594`), it failed to match `UI_RESERVATION_ITM_MNG_V2` unpadded number (`527594`).
    3. **`retryStep` Rejected Untracked GUI Reservations:** When an operator attempted to create TR / execute `retryStep` on an unseeded GUI reservation, `lockEntry` returned null and the action rejected with 404.
    4. **Scan-To (`/wm/scan-to`) 311 Transfer Posting Limitation:** In standard SAP WM, movement 311 transfer posting sets `LTBK-RSNUM` to `0000000000`. `getTRByReservation('0000527594')` in `TrToAdapter.js` queried `LTBK` with `RSNUM = '0000527594'`, throwing HTTP 404 even after a TR was generated.
  - **Remediation Delivered:**
    1. `srv/wm/reservation-entry/service.js`:
       - Added custom `this.on('READ', ReservationEntries, ...)` handler: for single-key entity lookups, if the record is missing from local persistence, it queries live SAP via `fetchSapReservation(sResNo, sResItem)`, fetches material description from `MAKT` (`SPRAS = 'E'`), warehouse from `T320`, checks `LTBK` for open TR, auto-imports into `ReservationEntries` with initial status `01` ("Reservation Created"), and creates an audit entry in `ReservationLogs`. Also supports both padded (`0000527594`) and unpadded (`527594`) single key reads.
       - Updated `retryStep`: if `track` is missing, auto-imports from SAP before proceeding to Step `LB01` (`L_TR_CREATE`) or `LT04`/`LT12`/`MIGO`.
       - Updated `getOpenReservations`: adds `Status_code: STATUS.RES_CREATED` (`'01'`) and `StatusText: 'Reservation Created'`.
    2. `srv/integration/s4hana/wm/TrToAdapter.js`:
       - In `getTRByReservation(rsnum, lgnum)`: added fallback check to `ReservationTrack` in `cds.db` querying both padded (`rs`) and unpadded (`rs.replace(/^0+/, '')`) reservation numbers so when `LTBK-RSNUM` is `0000000000` (standard for movement 311 transfer posting), it retrieves the TR directly from the tracked row.
    3. `app/fiori-app/webapp/modules/wm/reservation-entry/controller/ReservationEntryList.controller.js`:
       - In `loadData()`: normalized deduplication using `fnNorm` (stripped) and `fnPad` (10-digit) so `0000527594` and `527594` do not collide or double-list.
       - In `onSearchFieldSearch`: matches against both `sQuery` and `sQueryClean` (`sQuery.replace(/^0+/, '')`) so searching `0000527594` matches `527594` and vice-versa.
       - In `onRowPress`: pads `ReservationNo` to 10 digits when routing to detail.
    4. Unit Tests Added:

       - `test/unit/wm/trToAdapter.test.js`: Verified `getTRByReservation` fallback to `ReservationTrack`.
       - `test/unit/wm/reservationEntryUi.test.js`: Verified padded (`0000527594`) and unpadded (`527594`) search matching and list deduplication.

- **WM Handling Unit TO Confirmation Error (L3 848) Resolved & Complete HU Takeover Implemented (2026-10-12, 17:35 IST):**
  - **User Request:** `POST /odata/v4/tr-to/createTOFromTR` -> `Transfer Order 1037298 created, but confirmation failed (status 13): Confirm Transfer Order 1037298: TO item 0001037298 0001 does not contain a destination handling unit`.
  - **Diagnose & Root Cause:**
    1. **Transfer Order Created Successfully in SAP:** Transfer Order `1037298` was created for material `8000006485` (Plant `1120`, SLoc `CS02`) with 2 items for 2 NOS.
    2. **Handling Unit Sourced TO (`VEKP` / `LEIN`):** In `LTAP`, both items originated from Handling Units (`VLENR = 00000000002000020148` and `00000000002000020149`), with `FHUTA = '1'`.
    3. **Standard SAP HUM Confirmation Requirement:** When confirming an HU-managed TO, calling `L_TO_CONFIRM` without `T_LTAP_CONF_HU` triggers error `L3 848 ("TO item & & does not contain a destination handling unit")`. If `NACHU` is passed equal to `VONHU` without complete withdrawal, SAP throws `L3 893 ("Dest.handling same as source handling unit only allowed for HU takeover")`.
    4. **Solution Mechanism:** Passing `T_LTAP_CONF_HU` with complete HU withdrawal (`HUENT: 'X'`, `VONHU: item.VLENR`, `NACHU: item.NLENR || item.VLENR`) performs an authentic HU takeover, moving the source HU directly into the destination location and confirming the TO in SAP.
  - **Remediation Delivered:**
    1. `srv/integration/s4hana/wm/toState.js`:
       - Added `getHuConfirmationItems(rfc, lgnum, tanum)` to inspect `LTAP` items and construct `T_LTAP_CONF_HU` entries with complete HU withdrawal (`HUENT: 'X'`).
    2. `srv/integration/s4hana/wm/TrToAdapter.js` & `srv/integration/s4hana/wm/ReservationProcessAdapter.js`:
       - Updated `confirmTO` and `confirmTransferOrder` with reactive handling: attempts standard confirmation (zero overhead for non-HU items); when SAP rejects with `L3 848` (`destination handling unit`), dynamically calls `getHuConfirmationItems` and retries confirmation with `T_LTAP_CONF_HU`.
    3. `test/unit/wm/trToAdapter.test.js`:
       - Added unit test verifying reactive HU confirmation retry on `L3 848`.
    4. Live S/4HANA Verification:
       - Confirmed live TO `1037298` directly on S/4HANA Client 220: verified `LTAK-KQUIT = 'X'` and `LTAP-PQUIT = 'X'` across both items.
  - **Validation & Test Results:**
    - `npx jest test/unit/wm/trToAdapter.test.js`: **35/35 tests PASS**.
    - Full WM suite: `npx jest test/unit/wm/`: **65/65 test suites PASS, 1,357/1,357 tests PASS**.
    - `npx cds compile srv --to sql`: Clean (0 errors).
    - `git diff --check`: Clean (0 errors).


- **WM Storage Type Search Error (T334T / L3 007) Root Cause, SPRO Solution & LQUA ASCII Query Fix (2026-10-12, 17:15 IST):**
  - **User Request:** "Data for storage type search is not defined in warehouse W01 for WM movement type 311: missing customizing key in table T334T (Warehouse: W01, Operation: A [Stock Removal], Storage Type Indicator: 'EN1'). Maintain search sequence in SPRO: Logistics Execution > Warehouse Management > Strategies > Stock Removal Strategies > Determine Storage Type Search."
  - **Diagnose & Root Cause:**
    1. **SAP S/4HANA Customizing (Client 220):**
       - Querying `T334T` directly via RFC confirmed: Warehouse `W01` has stock placement (`KZEAR = 'E'`) entries for `EN1`, `FG1`, `GS1`, `OH1`, `RM1`, but stock removal (`KZEAR = 'A'`) ONLY has rows for blank (`***`) and `005`.
       - When standard SAP `L_TO_CREATE_TR` executes without explicit source storage type/bin (`VLTYP`/`VLPLA`), it executes `T334T_LESEN(W01, A, MLGN-LTKZA)`. Because the material master has `MLGN-LTKZA = 'EN1'`, SAP fails with `L3 007` because `(W01, A, EN1)` is missing from `T334T`.
    2. **Application Layer Bug in `srv/integration/s4hana/wm/TrToAdapter.js`:**
       - In `lookupTR` (line 655), the physical quant lookup in `LQUA` used `"AND LGTYP < '900'"`.
       - In ABAP OpenSQL / RFC_READ_TABLE, `LGTYP` is `CHAR(3)`. In ASCII collation, alphabetic characters are greater than '9' (`'E'` = 69, `'O'` = 79, `'R'` = 82 vs `'9'` = 57).
       - Consequently, all alphabetic storage types (`EN1`, `OH1`, `RM1`, `FG1`, `GS1`) were filtered out, causing `lookupTR` to return empty `SourceStorageType` and `SourceStorageBin`. When the UI called `createTOFromTR`, it sent blank values, forcing SAP into the failing `T334T` search.
  - **Remediation Delivered:**
    1. `srv/integration/s4hana/wm/TrToAdapter.js`:
       - Replaced `"AND LGTYP < '900'"` with `"AND LGTYP NOT LIKE '9%'"` in `lookupTR` so physical storage types starting with letters are not excluded.
       - Added `"AND LGTYP NOT LIKE '9%'"` to `whereLqua` in `getFifoBatches` to prevent recommending interim staging storage types (9xx).
    2. `test/unit/wm/trToAdapter.test.js`:
       - Added assertion that `readTable` for `LQUA` contains `"AND LGTYP NOT LIKE '9%'"`.
    3. Live S/4HANA Verification:
       - Verified live `lookupTR` for TR `1000809` (material `8000006485`, plant `1120`, SLoc `CS02`) immediately resolves `SourceStorageType: 'OH1'` and `SourceStorageBin: 'ONHOLD'` from `LQUA` instead of blank.
  - **Validation & Test Results:**
    - `npx jest test/unit/wm/trToAdapter.test.js`: **34/34 tests PASS**.
    - Full WM suite: `npx jest test/unit/wm/`: **65/65 test suites PASS, 1,356/1,356 tests PASS**.
    - `npx cds compile srv --to sql`: Clean (0 errors).
    - `git diff --check`: Clean (0 errors).

- **/wm/scan-to Transfer Order Creation & Posting Fix: Source Storage Type/Bin Determination & Live S/4HANA Verification (2026-10-12, 15:15 IST):**
  - **User Request:** `/wm/scan-to` — "Not post working here check and fix."
  - **Root Cause Isolated (CONFIRMED from live Client 220 RFC & standard ABAP `LL03AF18`):**
    1. In `/wm/scan-to`, posting `createTOFromTR` failed with SAP error `L3 007` ("Data for storage type search is not defined (A EN1 )") when source storage type and bin were blank.
    2. Standard SAP `L_TO_CREATE_TR` executes `T334T_LESEN(W01, A, MLGN-LTKZA)` when `VLTYP` and `VLPLA` are blank. Warehouse `W01` has no customizing rows in `T334T` for stock removal (`KZEAR: A`) for indicator `EN1` or `RM1` (only blank `***` and `005` exist).
    3. When explicit source storage type and bin are supplied in `IT_ITEMS` (e.g. `VLTYP: 'RM1', VLPLA: '0-L0001-00'`), SAP bypasses `T334T_LESEN` and creates the Transfer Order immediately (`EV_SUCCESS: 'S'`, verified live with TO `0001037293` created in Client 220).
    4. For TR `1000799` (material `8000009753`), TR was created for storage location `HS01`, but `HS01` has zero physical stock in `LQUA` (all quants are in `MT01`), leading to `L3 037` ("Storage type EN1 does not allow negative stock figures") when attempting to pick from `MT01`.
    5. For TR `1000800` (material `1000000204`, SLoc `CS01`), physical quants exist in `RM1 / 0-L0001-00` (>10,000 KG), allowing seamless TO creation.
  - **Remediation Delivered:**
    1. **CAP Service Model (`srv/wm/tr-to/service.cds`):**
       - Added optional `sourceStorageType : String(3)` and `sourceStorageBin : String(10)` parameters to `action createTOFromTR` and `action CreateTOFromTR`.
    2. **Key Validation (`srv/integration/s4hana/sapKey.js`):**
       - Added regex patterns `lgtyp` (`/^[A-Z0-9*]{1,3}$/`) and `lgpla` (`/^[A-Z0-9_\-./]{1,10}$/`).
    3. **S/4HANA Adapter (`srv/integration/s4hana/wm/TrToAdapter.js`):**
       - `lookupTR`: Automatically enriches `TRDetail` with `SourceStorageType` and `SourceStorageBin` from `suggestedBatches[0]` (if batch-managed) or queries `LQUA` for the first available physical quant (`LGTYP < 900`, `VERME > 0`).
       - `createTOFromTR`: Accepts `sourceStorageType` and `sourceStorageBin`. When provided by caller or UI, maps them directly into `IT_ITEMS[0].VLTYP` and `VLPLA`. If blank, leaves them blank (strictly respecting Fix 3 without unwanted LQUA queries inside `createTOFromTR`).
    4. **UI5 View & Controller (`WarehouseScanTo`):**
       - View: Added `scanToLabelSourceBin` displaying `Source Type / Bin (Pick From)` under TR Locations & Quantities.
       - Removed `title`, `showNavButton`, and `navButtonPress` from `<Page id="warehouseScanToPage">` (ShellBar owns both, satisfying UI consistency rule).
       - Added `noDataText="{i18n>scanToNoBatchesFound}"` to `tableSuggestedBatches`.
       - i18n: Added `scanToLabelSourceBin`, `scanToNoBatchesFound`, and synced all FIFO batch/serial keys to both `i18n.properties` and `i18n_en.properties`.
       - Controller: Tracks `sourceStorageType` and `sourceStorageBin` in `scanView` model; populates on `onLookupTR`, updates on `onApplyFifoBatch`, `onSelectBatchSuggestion`, `onSuggestionBatchSelected`; passes them in `oPayload` to `WarehouseScanToService.createTOFromTR`; resets to blank on `onReset`.

       - `T334U` (Access Strategy): 0 entries for `W01` (no fallback search sequences enabled).
       - `T334T` (Storage Type Search Sequence): Putaway (`KZEAR: E`) has `EN1` defined (`W01/E/EN1 -> LGTY0: 'EN1', LGTY1: '003'`). Stock Removal (`KZEAR: A`) only has rows for `LGTKZ = ''` (`***`) and `LGTKZ = '005'` (`005`). Key `(LGNUM = 'W01', KZEAR = 'A', LGTKZ = 'EN1')` is missing from `T334T`.

    6. Root Cause: **(a) missing customizing in table T334T for stock removal key `(LGNUM = 'W01', KZEAR = 'A', LGTKZ = 'EN1')`**.     3. `TrToAdapter.js` & `trTo.handler.js`: Omitted `MovementType`, `IsConfirmed`, `ConfirmationNumber`, `ConfirmedBy` from returned object; when MIGO succeeded, `result.Batch` and `result.ReservationNo` were not updated from resolved values.
    4. `WarehouseScanTo.controller.js`: In `onProcessTO`, `oResult` was not normalized with TR context (Material, MaterialName, Quantity, Unit, Batch, MovementType, TransferRequirement, ReservationNo) before clearing `/tr`. On `onRetryMigo`, `StatusText`, `Batch`, `ReservationNo`, `MovementType`, and `IsConfirmed` were not updated.
  - **Resolution Architecture Implemented:**
    1. Extended `TOProcessResult` in `service.cds` and adapters/handlers with `MovementType: String(3)`, `IsConfirmed: Boolean`, `ConfirmationNumber: String(10)`, and `ConfirmedBy: String(12)`.
    2. Normalized and enriched `oResult` in `WarehouseScanTo.controller.js` on both `onProcessTO` and `onRetryMigo`.
    3. Redesigned `panelResult` in `WarehouseScanTo.view.xml` with two structured groups: (A) Transfer Order Details (TO, TR/Reservation, Human-readable Status text with semantic state, Confirmed By) and (B) Material & Stock Posting (Material & Description, Pick Quantity & Movement Type, Batch, Material Document & Year, Stock Effect, Error Details if any).
    4. Dynamic MessageStrip type based on status (Success, Warning on 99, Error on 13).

    - `npx jest test/unit/wm/autoMigoPosting.test.js`: **10/10 tests passed**.

- **Bugfix & Live Proof: `/wm/scan-to` MIGO Goods Movement Batch Resolution & TO 1037284 MIGO Posting (2026-10-12):**
  - **Issue Reported:** `/wm/scan-to`: `Transfer Order 1037284 confirmed, but MIGO Goods Movement failed: BAPI_GOODSMVT_CREATE failed: Enter Batch`.
  - **Root Cause Isolated:**
    1. In `srv/wm/tr-to/service.cds`, actions `postMigoGoodsMovement` and `PostMigoGoodsMovement` lacked `Batch: String(10)` and `Serials: array of String(18)` in parameters and `MigoProcessResult`.
    2. In `srv/wm/tr-to/handlers/trTo.handler.js`, lines 285–303 (`handleCreateTOFromTR` auto-chaining MIGO when `autoPostMigo: true`) omitted `Batch` and `Serials` when calling `handlePostMigoGoodsMovement`.
    3. In `handlePostMigoGoodsMovement`, batch and serials were neither extracted from incoming payload nor passed to `resProcessAdapter.postGoodsMovement`.
    4. In `app/fiori-app/webapp/modules/wm/warehouse-scan-to/controller/WarehouseScanTo.controller.js` line 606 (`onRetryMigo`), `oPayload` omitted `Batch` and `Serials`.
    5. In `ReservationProcessAdapter.js`, line 360 strictly required `ReservationNo` (`if (!reservationNo) throw httpError(400, 'ReservationNo is mandatory');`), blocking direct TO movements where `RSNUM` was all zeros, and lacked multi-tier fallback resolution.
  - **Resolution Architecture Implemented:**
    1. Added `Batch: String(10)` and `Serials: array of String(18)` to `MigoProcessResult`, `postMigoGoodsMovement`, and `PostMigoGoodsMovement` in CDS.
    2. Multi-tier Batch Resolution in both handler and adapter:
       - Tier 1: User / API provided `Batch` / `Serials`.
       - Tier 2: Read batch from confirmed Transfer Order in `LTAP` (`TANUM`).
       - Tier 3: Read batch from reservation in `RESB` (`RSNUM`).
       - Tier 4: Read batch from interim storage quants in `LQUA` (`LGTYP IN ('921', '920')`).
    3. Refined `ReservationProcessAdapter.postGoodsMovement`: Allows direct goods movement when `transferOrder` is provided or auto-resolves open reservations from `RESB` for the material/plant/movement type; properly sets `RESERV_NO`, `RES_ITEM`, `NO_MORE_GR` only when a reservation is present.
    4. Propagated `Batch` and `Serials` in UI `WarehouseScanTo.controller.js` on `onRetryMigo`.

- **Feature: Chained TO Execution (Create TO then Confirm TO as Two Real Sequential Calls) & Retry Separation — Resolved & Validated (2026-10-10):**
  - **Change Request:** Implement chained Transfer Order execution (CREATE TO via `Z_WM_TO_CREATE_FROM_TR`, then CONFIRM TO via `L_TO_CONFIRM` as a real second call) in one step across both Node/CAP adapters and ABAP repository classes (`docs/abap/`).
  - **Interface Discoveries from Live SAP Client 220 (via RFC):**
    1. `Z_WM_TO_CREATE_FROM_TR`:
       - Importing: `IV_LGNUM` (LGNUM), `IV_TBNUM` (LTBK-TBNUM), `IV_SQUIT` (CHAR1, default `' '`), `IV_COMMIT` (CHAR1, default `'X'`).
       - Exporting: `EV_TANUM` (LTAK-TANUM), `EV_SUCCESS` (CHAR1), `EV_MESSAGE` (BAPI_MSG).
       - Tables: `IT_ITEMS` (L03B_TRITE_T), `ET_MESSAGES` (BAPIRET2_T).
       - Immediate confirmation parameter: **CONFIRMED: YES (`IV_SQUIT` exists in `Z_WM_TO_CREATE_FROM_TR`)**.
    2. `L_TO_CONFIRM`:
       - Importing: `I_LGNUM`, `I_TANUM`, `I_SQUIT` (RL03T), `I_COMMIT_WORK` (RL03B).
       - Tables: `T_LTAP_CONF` (LTAP_CONF).
       - Exceptions: `TO_CONFIRMED` (1), `TO_DOESNT_EXIST` (2), `ITEM_CONFIRMED` (3), `FOREIGN_LOCK` (12), `SQUIT_OR_QUANTITIES` (13).
  - **Implementation Architecture Delivered:**
    1. Chained Execution: `createTOFromTR` in `TrToAdapter.js` calls `Z_WM_TO_CREATE_FROM_TR` with `IV_SQUIT: ' '`. Upon create success, `tanum` is captured and status `03` persisted. Then `confirmTO` calls `L_TO_CONFIRM` with `tanum`. On confirm success, status advances to `04` (`TO Confirmed`).
    2. Error Handling & State Preservation:
       - Create failure: Status `12`, `ErrorStep: 'LT04'`, error message preserved.
       - Confirm failure: Status `13`, `ErrorStep: 'LT12'`, `TransferOrder` (`TANUM`) strictly preserved.
    3. Duplicate TO Prevention & Retry Separation:
       - Never creates a second TO when `TANUM` already exists on the tracking record.
       - If `TANUM` exists with status `04`: duplicate creation is rejected with 400.
       - If `TANUM` exists with status `13`: skips create step and retries confirm only.
    4. ABAP Parity:
       - `docs/abap/zcl_res_process.clas.abap`: Implemented `create_and_confirm_to` and updated `confirm_to` to accept `iv_conf_menge`.
       - `docs/abap/zcl_res_process_bgpf.clas.abap`: Implemented chained execution in `WHEN 'LT04'`, intermediate commit after create, duplicate TO guard, and retry confirm in `WHEN 'LT12'`.
    5. Unit Testing:
       - `test/unit/wm/createTOFromTR.test.js` updated and labeled `"[mock only, not SAP verification]"`.
       - Added 4 test scenarios: (A) create ok + confirm ok, (B) create ok + confirm fail (keeps `TANUM`, status `13`), (C) retry confirm only, (D) retry blocked on already confirmed TO.
  - **Validation & Results:**

    `400 Bad Request: {"error":{"message":"Movement type 000 does not allow immediate confirmation","code":"400"}}`.
  - **Root Cause Discovered:**
    1. Unconditional Fallback in `TrToAdapter.js`: `createTOFromTR` invoked primary wrapper `Z_WM_TO_CREATE_FROM_TR` (which correctly passes `IV_SQUIT: ' '`) inside a `try ... catch (primaryErr)` block that caught all errors and fell back to legacy wrapper `ZWM_TO_CREATE_FROM_TR`.
    2. Hardcoded `i_squit = 'X'` in Legacy Wrapper: `ZWM_TO_CREATE_FROM_TR` hardcodes `i_squit = 'X'` when invoking standard FM `L_TO_CREATE_TR`. Because immediate confirmation is not configured in table `T333` for this movement type, SAP throws exception `squit_forbidden` (message `L3 045: Movement type 000 does not allow immediate confirmation`).
    3. Customizing Mismatch in TR 1000755: The primary call failed because material `8000000023` in TR 1000755 has stock removal indicator `LTKZA = 'EN1'` in `MLGN`. Customizing table `T334T` in warehouse `W01` defines `EN1` only for Putaway (`KZEAR = 'E'`), but has no entry for Removal (`KZEAR = 'A'`), throwing `Data for storage type search is not defined (A EN1  )`.
    4. Hardcoded `LETYP: 'E1'`: Storage unit type defaulted to `'E1'` (Europallet), triggering palletization checks on materials without pallet data.
    5. Masked Diagnostic: The fallback swallowed the real SAP customizing error (`Data for storage type search is not defined`) and returned the false immediate confirmation error.
  - **Resolution:**
    1. In `srv/integration/s4hana/wm/TrToAdapter.js`:
       - Removed unconditional fallback to `ZWM_TO_CREATE_FROM_TR` on business and customizing errors.
       - Restricted legacy fallback exclusively to missing function module exceptions (`FU_NOT_FOUND`).
       - Defaulted `LETYP` to `''` instead of `'E1'` when not defined in TR or material master.

- **Fix: Reservation Process Step LB01 Retry & TR Creation Restricted by SAP Note 2295840 — Resolved via Deployed RFC Wrappers Z_WM_TR_CREATE / ZWM_TR_CREATE & Proven Live (2026-10-10):**
  - **Issue Reported:** On route `/wm/reservation-entry/0000524979/0001`, retrying step `LB01` threw:
    `Error : Retry LB01 deferred: L_TR_CREATE restricted by SAP Note 2295840 (use LB01 or deploy ZWM_TR_CREATE)`.
  - **Root Causes Discovered:**
    1. RFC Restriction under SAP Note 2295840: Standard SAP function module `L_TR_CREATE` is blacklisted for remote RFC invocation via UCON. Calling it directly results in RFC exception `Incompatible Call Rejected, see note 2295840`.
    2. S/4HANA Material Number Formatting: S/4HANA material fields are 40 characters long. However, calling `|{ iv_matnr ALPHA = IN }|` pads to 40 characters with leading zeros, which standard material routines reject with `M3 305: The material & does not exist or is not activated`. S/4HANA requires standard conversion routine `CONVERSION_EXIT_MATN1_INPUT` to correctly format 18-digit materials (e.g. `8000000023` -> `000000008000000023`).
    3. Quantity Data Element: `L_TR_CREATE` table parameter `T_LTBA` item field `MENGA` uses data element `LTBP_MENGA`. Passing generic integers or `MENGA` without matching types can trigger conversion warnings.
    4. Adapter Zero-Document Fallback: In `ReservationProcessAdapter.js`, `createTransferOrderFromTR` did not validate that returned `tanum` was a non-zero document number before returning success, which could lead to calling `confirmTransferOrder` with `'0000000000'` on TO creation failures.
  - **Resolution:**
    1. Authored, deployed, and activated remote-enabled RFC wrapper `Z_WM_TR_CREATE` via SAP ADT with stateful session handling (`X-sap-adt-sessiontype: stateful`) in Function Group `Z_VENDOR_REMOTES` (package `$TMP`). Uses `CONVERSION_EXIT_MATN1_INPUT`, `CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT`, and `LTBP_MENGA` for type safety and calls `L_TR_CREATE` internally.
    2. Authored, deployed, and activated remote-enabled RFC wrapper alias `ZWM_TR_CREATE` in Function Group `Z_VENDOR_REMOTES` forwarding directly to `Z_WM_TR_CREATE`.
    3. In `srv/integration/s4hana/wm/ReservationProcessAdapter.js`:
       - Updated `createTransferRequirement` to call `ZWM_TR_CREATE` with fallback to `Z_WM_TR_CREATE`, verifying clean document number before returning success.
       - Updated `createTransferOrderFromTR` to call `ZWM_TO_CREATE_FROM_TR` with fallback to `Z_WM_TO_CREATE_FROM_TR` and reject zero/empty document numbers with descriptive SAP error.
  - **Live SAP S/4HANA Validation:**
    - Live node-rfc test: Successfully created Transfer Requirements `0001000751`, `0001000752`, and `0001000753` directly in SAP S/4HANA Client 220 (`DS4CLNT220`).
    - Live CAP dev server test: `POST http://localhost:4004/odata/v4/reservation-entry/retryStep` for reservation `0000524979` item `0001` with `Step: 'LB01'`: **HTTP 200 OK**, status updated to `'02'` ("TR Created"), TransferRequirement populated with SAP-created TR `0001000754`!
    - Verified in SAP table `LTBP`: TR `0001000754` persisted for reservation `0000524979` with material `000000008000000023`, quantity 1 NOS in plant 1120 / SLoc HS01.
    - `ui5lint` in `app/fiori-app`: 0 findings (clean).
    - `git diff --check`: 0 errors (clean).
    - Full repository WM test suite (`npx jest test/unit/wm/`): **63/63 test suites passed, 1,269/1,269 unit tests passed (100% green)**.

- **Fix: WarehouseScanTo TO Creation Immediate Confirmation Error (Movement Type 000 / Note 2295840) & UI5 Class Setting Assertions — Resolved & Proven Live (2026-10-10):**
  - **Issue Reported:**
    1. UI5 console assertions: `Assertion failed: ManagedObject.apply: encountered unknown setting 'class' for class 'sap.m.Text' (value:'textMuted')`, `... 'sap.m.HBox' (value:'sapUiTinyMarginTop sapUiTinyMarginBottom')`, `... 'sap.m.VBox' (value:'sapUiSmallMargin')`.
    2. TO Creation 400 Bad Request: `POST http://localhost:4004/odata/v4/tr-to/createTOFromTR 400 (Bad Request)` with message: `"Movement type 000 does not allow immediate confirmation"`.
  - **Root Causes Discovered:**
    1. UI5 Class Setting: In `app/fiori-app/webapp/service/BarcodeScanService.js`, programmatic UI5 constructors used `class: "..."` in their settings objects. In SAPUI5, `class` is an HTML attribute, not a managed property of `ManagedObject`/`Control`. Programmatic controls require `.addStyleClass(...)`.
    2. Hardcoded Immediate Confirmation in SAP Wrapper: Legacy RFC wrapper `ZWM_TO_CREATE_FROM_TR` hardcoded `i_squit = 'X'` when invoking standard function module `L_TO_CREATE_TR`. In SAP WM configuration (table `T333`), movement types such as 101 (Goods Receipt Putaway) do not permit immediate confirmation during TO creation (`squit_forbidden` exception 8), throwing message `Movement type 000 does not allow immediate confirmation`.
    3. Storage Unit Type (LETYP) Requirement: Warehouse `W01` is Storage Unit managed. When creating a Transfer Order for a material without a default storage unit type maintained in `MLGN-LETY1`, SAP requires `LETYP` (e.g. `E1` Euro Pallet) in `IT_ITEMS`, otherwise rejecting with error `L3 043 Enter the storage unit type`.
    4. Premature Confirmation Handling: When a Transfer Order is put away or confirmed, subsequent calls to `L_TO_CONFIRM` return message `L3 055 All items in transfer order & already confirmed`, which was previously unhandled and treated as an error instead of confirmation success.
  - **Resolution:**
    1. In `app/fiori-app/webapp/service/BarcodeScanService.js`:
       - Introduced safe helper `_addClass(oControl, sClass)` that calls `oControl.addStyleClass(sClass)` if available.
       - Replaced all invalid `class: "..."` constructor properties on `VBox`, `HBox`, `Label`, and `Text`.
    2. ABAP RFC Wrapper Deployment (`Z_WM_TO_CREATE_FROM_TR`):
       - Connected to SAP S/4HANA via ADT with stateful session headers (`X-sap-adt-sessiontype: stateful`).
       - Successfully authored, deployed, and activated remote-enabled function module `Z_WM_TO_CREATE_FROM_TR` in Function Group `Z_VENDOR_REMOTES` (package `$TMP`).
       - Implemented configurable `iv_squit` defaulting to `' '` (creation without immediate confirmation).
       - Automatically defaults `ls_trite-letyp` to `'E1'` if empty, resolving `L3 043 Enter the storage unit type`.
    3. In `srv/integration/s4hana/wm/TrToAdapter.js`:
       - In `createTOFromTR`: Calls primary wrapper `Z_WM_TO_CREATE_FROM_TR` passing `IV_SQUIT: ' '` and defaults `LETYP: 'E1'`, with automatic fallback to `ZWM_TO_CREATE_FROM_TR`.
       - In `confirmTO`: Catches message `L3 055` ("already confirmed") and treats it as confirmation success.
    4. In `test/unit/wm/barcodeScanService.test.js`:
       - Added `addStyleClass` method to mock UI5 control constructors.
  - **Live SAP S/4HANA Validation:**
    - Live RFC test creating TO from TR 1000750 item 0001: Transfer Order `0001037262` created in SAP S/4HANA Client 220 (`DS4CLNT220`).
    - Verified `LTAK` and `LTAP` records directly in SAP with `KQUIT = 'X'` and `PQUIT = 'X'`.
    - Live end-to-end CAP OData V4 call `POST :4004/odata/v4/tr-to/createTOFromTR`: **HTTP 200 OK** creating and confirming Transfer Order `1037264`.
    - `ui5lint` in `app/fiori-app`: 0 findings (clean).

- **Fix: WarehouseScanTo TR Lookup Property Mismatch, Prefix Stripping & Deferred TR Detection — Resolved & Validated (2026-10-10):**
  - **Issue Reported:** In `/wm/scan-to`, scanning or entering a Transfer Requirement threw:
    `Error : Transfer Requirement not found or has no open quantity.`
  - **Root Cause & Technical Analysis:**
    1. Property Name Mismatch: In `WarehouseScanTo.controller.js` line 265, `onLookupTR` checked `if (!oDetail || !oDetail.TRNumber) throw new Error(that.getText("scanToErrNotFound"));`. However, the backend OData V4 service (`srv/wm/tr-to/service.cds` and `TrToAdapter.js`) defines and returns `TransferRequirement`, `OpenQuantity`, `MaterialName`, `RequiredQuantity`, `DestinationStorageType`, `DestinationStorageBin`. Because `oDetail.TRNumber` was `undefined`, the controller evaluated `!oDetail.TRNumber === true` and threw `scanToErrNotFound` ("Transfer Requirement not found or has no open quantity") even though the backend returned HTTP 200 OK with valid TR and open stock.
    2. Missing Reservation Barcode Fallback & Deferred TR Detection: When searching in `TrToAdapter.js`, `getTR` only passed `IV_TR_NUMBER` to `Z_WM_GET_TR_MATERIAL_LIST`. If the operator scanned the reservation barcode for a reservation whose TR creation was deferred under SAP Note 2295840 (e.g. `525273`), no TR was found, leading to a misleading generic error.
    3. Prefix Formatting & Value Help Fallback: Barcode scanners or manual entry often include prefixes (e.g. `"TR 1000750"`, `"TR:1000750"`). Furthermore, `TrSelectDialog.fragment.xml` bound `title` to `DisplayText` (`"TR 1000750 (Mvt 101)"`), which if used as a fallback in `onConfirmTRValueHelp` was rejected as non-numeric by backend regex.
  - **Resolution:**
    1. In `srv/integration/s4hana/wm/TrToAdapter.js`:
       - Enhanced `getTR`: Strips prefixes (`TR[\s:-]*`), performs fallback lookup by `IV_RESERVATION`, and if neither exists, checks table `RKPF` to detect if the number is an existing reservation whose TR creation was deferred, providing an actionable diagnostic message.
       - Enhanced `lookupTR`: Populates both standard backend and UI model aliases (`TRNumber` & `TransferRequirement`, `OpenQty` & `OpenQuantity`, `TargetQty` & `RequiredQuantity`, `MaterialDescription` & `MaterialName`, `DestinationType` & `DestinationStorageType`, `DestinationBin` & `DestinationStorageBin`).
    2. In `WarehouseScanToService.js`:
       - In `lookupTR`: Strips any `TR` prefix from `sTbnum` before building the OData function URL and normalizes incoming OData response to map all alias fields.
    3. In `WarehouseScanTo.controller.js`:
       - In `onLookupTR`: Extracts numeric digits (`\b\d{4,10}\b`) from raw input and validates against `oDetail.TRNumber || oDetail.TransferRequirement`, preventing false-positive not found exceptions.
       - In `onConfirmTRValueHelp`: Extracts numeric `Tbnum` with regex fallback from item title if binding context is unavailable.
       - In `createTO`: Passes `tbnum: oTR.TRNumber || oTR.TransferRequirement`.
    4. In `TrSelectDialog.fragment.xml`:
       - Bound `title="{scanView>Tbnum}"` and `description="{scanView>DisplayText}"` so the item title provides the clean TR number.
  - **Validation:**
    - Live HTTP check on `:4004/odata/v4/tr-to/lookupTR(tbnum='0001000750',lgnum='W01')`: **HTTP 200 OK** with 3,000 KG open quantity.
    - `ui5lint` in `app/fiori-app`: 0 findings (clean).
    - `git diff --check`: 0 errors (clean).
    - Targeted unit tests (`npx jest test/unit/wm/warehouseScanToUi.test.js test/unit/wm/trToAdapter.test.js`): 52/52 tests passed.
    - TrTo test suite (`npx jest test/unit/wm/trToAdapter.test.js test/unit/wm/trToController.test.js test/unit/wm/trToHandler.test.js test/unit/wm/trToService.test.js test/unit/wm/createTOFromTR.test.js test/unit/wm/warehouseScanToUi.test.js`): 119/119 tests passed.
    - Full repository WM test suite (`npx jest test/unit/wm/`): **63/63 test suites passed, 1,269/1,269 unit tests passed (100% green)**.

- **Fix: Auto TR Creation Deferred / Note 2295840 RFC Blacklist Handling & ZWM_TR_CREATE Wrapper Spec — Resolved & Validated (2026-10-10):**
  - **Issue Reported:** Reservation creation succeeded in SAP S/4HANA (e.g. `0000525273`), but the automated second step (Transfer Requirement creation) failed with:
    `Auto TR creation deferred/failed: Incompatible Call Rejected, see note 2295840; Called Incompatible Function :L_TR_CREATECPROG:nodeDEST:vheudds4a`
  - **Root Cause & Technical Analysis:**
    1. Under SAP S/4HANA (Note 2295840 / UCON), classic function module `L_TR_CREATE` is placed on the SAP RFC Blacklist for external RFC clients (`node-rfc` calling `CPROG:nodeDEST:vheudds4a`). External execution is blocked by the SAP RFC Gateway to prevent incompatible calls.
    2. Internal ABAP execution of `L_TR_CREATE` inside SAP remains 100% supported. This mirrors how `L_TO_CREATE_TR` was resolved on this system: by creating remote-enabled wrapper `ZWM_TO_CREATE_FROM_TR` in Function Group `ZWM_FINISHEDGOODS`.
    3. The reservation itself (`RSNUM 0000525273`) is completely valid, committed and persisted in SAP (`DS4CLNT220`).
  - **Resolution:**
    1. `srv/integration/s4hana/wm/ReservationProcessAdapter.js`:
       - Enhanced `createTransferRequirement`: Added fallback support for custom RFC wrapper `ZWM_TR_CREATE` (matching `ZWM_TO_CREATE_FROM_TR`).
       - If `L_TR_CREATE` is rejected by Note 2295840 and `ZWM_TR_CREATE` is not yet available, cleanly classifies the error with `code = 'UCON_BLOCKED'` and an actionable explanation: `L_TR_CREATE is restricted under SAP Note 2295840 (RFC blacklist). Requires custom RFC wrapper ZWM_TR_CREATE or manual creation via transaction LB01.`
    2. `srv/wm/reservation-entry/service.js`:
       - In `executeReservationAndAutoTR`: Formatted warning log and track record note cleanly (`TR deferred: restricted under SAP Note 2295840 (use LB01 or deploy ZWM_TR_CREATE)`), preserving status `01` (Reservation Created) without alarming raw RFC dump.
       - In `retryStep`: Handles step `LB01` retry failure due to Note 2295840 cleanly with operational guidance.
    3. `app/fiori-app/webapp/modules/wm/reservation-entry/controller/ReservationEntryDetail.controller.js`:
       - Success dialog now informs the user constructively: `"Reservation <resNo> created successfully. Note: TR deferred: restricted under SAP Note 2295840 (use LB01 or deploy ZWM_TR_CREATE)."`
    4. ABAP Implementation & Specification:

       - Created complete ABAP source code: `docs/wm-discovery/pass2/fm_ZWM_TR_CREATE.abap` (Package `Z001`, Function Group `ZWM_FINISHEDGOODS`).

- **Fix: Reservation Creation 400 Error (BAPI_RESERVATION_CREATE1 master data & MOVE_PLANT) — Resolved & Proven Live (2026-10-10):**
  - **Issue Reported:** POST `/odata/v4/reservation-entry/createReservationEntry` returned 400 Bad Request:
    `"Failed to create reservation: BAPI_RESERVATION_CREATE1 failed: Storage location CS01 does not exist; No storage location data for 1000000045 in 1120 HS01; Not possible to carry out conversion; No instance of object type BUS2093 has been created."`
  - **Root Causes Discovered via Live SAP Inspection:**
    1. `Storage location CS01 does not exist`: In `BAPI_RESERVATION_CREATE1`, SAP requires `MOVE_PLANT` in `RESERVATIONHEADER` to evaluate the receiving storage location `MOVE_STLOC`. For movement 311 (intra-plant SLoc transfer), `receivingPlant` is not specified by the user, so `MOVE_PLANT` was omitted. Without a plant context, SAP reported that the receiving storage location does not exist.
    2. `No storage location data for 1000000045 in 1120 HS01`: Material 1000000045 is Raw Material (`ZROH`) and is maintained in SLocs `CS01` (Raw Material), `ST02` (Storage Tank), `PWIP`, etc. (`MARD`), but is NOT maintained in `HS01` (Engineering store).
    3. `Not possible to carry out conversion`: The Base Unit of Measure in `MARA` for material 1000000045 is `KG`, not `NOS`.
  - **Resolution:**
    1. In `srv/integration/s4hana/wm/ReservationProcessAdapter.js`: Set `MOVE_PLANT` to `receivingPlant || (movementType === '311' ? plant : '')`, ensuring SAP evaluates `MOVE_STLOC` within the issuing plant context. Set `ENTRY_UOM` to uppercase `KG` fallback.
    2. In `srv/wm/reservation-entry/service.js`: Ensured `receivingPlant` is passed as `Plant` for 311 transfers, and unit defaults to `KG`.
    3. In `ReservationEntryDetail.controller.js`: Aligned default create data with authentic SAP master data for Plant 1120: `StorageLocation: "CS01"`, `ReceivingStorageLocation: "ST02"`, `Unit: "KG"`, `CostCenter: "1011201301"`.
  - **Live SAP S/4HANA Validation:**
    - Live HTTP POST to `http://localhost:4004/odata/v4/reservation-entry/createReservationEntry` succeeded with **HTTP 200 OK**.
    - Confirmed authentic SAP Reservation **`0000525273`** created and committed in SAP S/4HANA Client 220 (`DS4CLNT220`).

- **Fix: ModuleError sap/m/Badge.js in ReservationEntryList — Resolved & Tested (2026-10-10):**
  - **Issue Reported:** When navigating to route `/wm/reservation-entry`, UI5 loader failed with `failed to load JavaScript resource: sap/m/Badge.js` and `The following error occurred while displaying routing target with name 'TargetReservationEntryList': ModuleError: failed to load 'sap/m/Badge.js'`.
  - **Root Cause:** In `app/fiori-app/webapp/modules/wm/reservation-entry/view/ReservationEntryList.view.xml` line 116, `<Badge id="badgeCount" text="{= ${view>/entries}.length }" class="sapUiTinyMarginBegin" />` was used under the default `xmlns="sap.m"` namespace. `sap.m.Badge` is not a standalone control in SAPUI5/OpenUI5.
  - **Resolution:** Replaced `<Title id="lblResTableTitle" ...>` and `<Badge id="badgeCount" ...>` with standard title counter expression `<Title id="lblResTableTitle" text="{= ${i18n>resEntryTableHeading} + ' (' + (${view>/entries}.length || 0) + ')' }" level="H3" />` matching standard repository conventions (`GoodsReceipt.view.xml`, `Open261.view.xml`, `GoodsIssue311Pending.view.xml`).

       - Section 4 (Audit Trail Logs): Added columns for `Msg Class / No` (`MessageId / MessageNo`) and `Log Handle` (`BALLOGHNDL`), displaying structured SLG1 logs.
  2. **Retry Action per Failed Step (`retryStep`):**
     - Service action `retryStep(ReservationNo, ReservationItem, Step)` declared in `srv/wm/reservation-entry/service.cds` and implemented in `service.js`:
       - Evaluates current record status dynamically when `Step='AUTO'` or per explicit step:
         - Missing TR or status `01` $\rightarrow$ retries `LB01` (`createTransferRequirement`), advances to status `02`.
         - Missing TO or status `02` $\rightarrow$ retries `LT04` (`createTransferOrderFromTR`) & `LT12` (`confirmTransferOrder`), advances to status `04`.
         - Status `03` $\rightarrow$ retries `LT12` (`confirmTransferOrder`), advances to status `04`.
         - Status `04` or `99` $\rightarrow$ retries `MIGO` (`postGoodsMovement`), sets `MaterialDocument` and advances to status `05`.
       - On retry error: safely captures failure, sets `Status_code = '99'`, persists `ErrorMessage`, logs error entry in `ReservationLogs` with SLG1 correlation, and commits DB state without unhandled exception.
  3. **Application Log (`SLG1`) Integration:**
     - Extended CDS models in `db/wm/reservation-track.cds`: Added `LogHandle : String(22)` (`BALLOGHNDL`), `ExternalId : String(100)` (`BALEXTN`), and `SubObject : String(20)` (`BALSUBOBJ`) to `ReservationTrack` and `ReservationLog`.
     - In `srv/integration/s4hana/wm/ReservationProcessAdapter.js`: Added `writeApplicationLog` (Object `ZWM_RES`, Subobject `TRACK`/`PROCESS`) wrapping `BAL_LOG_CREATE`, `BAL_LOG_MSG_ADD`, and `BAL_DB_SAVE` with safe fallback, and `readApplicationLogs` wrapping `BAL_GLB_SEARCH_LOG`.
     - Added function `getApplicationLogs(ReservationNo, ReservationItem)` in `service.cds` returning step-wise audit history.
  4. **ABAP Model Alignment (`docs/abap/`):**

- **Serial Number vs Storage Unit Root Cause Diagnosis & Full-Stack Intelligent Resolution (2026-10-09):** In response to user request `What is the issues find root causes and fix. Serial number 1000046083 does not exist in SAP for material 8000000001. Serial number 2000020148 does not exist in SAP for material 8000006485`:
  1. **Root Cause Analysis (Live SAP Client 220 Evidence):**
     - **Entity Mismatch (Classic WM Storage Unit vs Serial Number):** Scanned numbers `1000046083` and `2000020148` are **Classic LE-WM Storage Units** (`LENUM` in SAP table `LQUA`), NOT equipment serial numbers (`SERNR` in SAP table `EQUI` / OData `UI_MATERIALSERIALNUMBER/C_MaterialSerialNumber`).
     - **Material `8000006485`:** In Plant `1120`, SLoc `CS02`, `2000020148` is quant `LQUA.LENUM = '00000000002000020148'` in Warehouse `W01`, Type `OH1`, Bin `ONHOLD` (1.000 NOS). The actual unrestricted serial numbers in SAP stock (`C_MaterialSerialNumber` with `StockType = '01'`) are `CON-40-002`, `CON-40-003`, `CON-40-004`, `CON-40-005`.
     - **Material `8000000001`:** In Plant `1120`, SLoc `HS01`, `1000046083` is quant `LQUA.LENUM = '00000000001000046083'` in Warehouse `W13`, Type `RM1`, Bin `0-L0001-03` (5.000 NOS). The actual unrestricted serial numbers in SAP stock (`C_MaterialSerialNumber` with `StockType = '01'`) are `110`, `AIL-IPHONE-0000001`, `AIL-IPHONE-0000002`, `AIL-IPHONE-0000003`, `IPHONE1612345678`, `IPHONE16123456789`, `JBNRCV12354Q`, etc.
     - **Error Mechanism:** When operators scan a pallet SU barcode into the Serial Number field, the backend previously queried only `EQUI`. Finding 0 rows, it returned `NOT_FOUND` ("Serial number ... does not exist in SAP for material ..."), leaving operators confused with no guidance.
  2. **Backend Fix (`srv/integration/s4hana/` & `srv/wm/goods-issue/`):**
     - In `GoodsIssueStockUnitClient.js` (`getSerialStatus`): when `EQUI` returns 0 rows, check if the scanned number exists as a Storage Unit in `LQUA`. If found, returns `Status: 'IS_STORAGE_UNIT'`, `IsStorageUnit: true`, `StorageUnit: <su>`, `StorageType`, `StorageBin`, `Warehouse`, `Material`, `AvailableStock`, and diagnostic message explaining it is a Storage Unit, not a Serial Number.
     - Added `getAvailableSerialNumbers(material, plant, storageLocation)` in `GoodsIssueStockUnitClient.js` querying `C_MaterialSerialNumber` for `InventoryStockType eq '01'` (excluding special stock).
     - In `GoodsIssueAdapter.js`, exposed `getSerialStatus` and `getAvailableSerialNumbers({ reservationNo, reservationItem, material, plant, storageLocation })`.
     - In `service.cds` and `goodsIssue.handler.js`, exposed function `getAvailableSerialNumbers` and added `IsStorageUnit` and SU fields to `SerialVerification`.
  3. **Frontend Fix (`app/fiori-app/`):**
     - In `GoodsIssueTransferBaseController.js` (`onAddSerialPress`): auto-detects when an operator scans or submits a Storage Unit barcode (either matching known candidate SUs or returning `IS_STORAGE_UNIT` from SAP), automatically routes it to `selectedStorageUnit`, sets `suScanState = Success`, sets `suScanText`, clears `serialInput`, and displays informative toast and feedback.
     - In `GoodsIssueTransferBaseController.js`, implemented `onSerialValueHelp()`: opens a `SelectDialog` populated from SAP `getAvailableSerialNumbers`, with live search filtering, 1-click serial selection, and immediate validation.
     - In `GoodsIssue311.view.xml` and `GoodsIssue301.view.xml`: enabled `showValueHelp="true"`, `valueHelpRequest=".onSerialValueHelp"`, and added Value Help button `btnSerialHelp311` / `btnSerialHelp301` on `inSerialScan311` / `inSerialScan301`.
     - In `GoodsIssue311Service.js` and `GoodsIssue301Service.js`: implemented `getAvailableSerialNumbers`.
     - In `i18n.properties` and `i18n_en.properties`: added localized strings for SU auto-routing and serial value help.
  4. **Validation:** 100% passed unit tests across `goodsIssue311Controller.test.js` (68/68 passed), `goodsIssue311Serial.test.js` (34/34 passed), `goodsIssue311ViewStructure.test.js` (17/17 passed), `goodsIssueService.test.js` (36/36 passed), `ui5lint` passed with 0 findings, `git diff --check` passed with 0 errors.

Implemented optimizations in `srv/integration/s4hana/wm/HandlingUnitAdapter.js`: (1) Increased `PAGE` from 200 to 1,000, fetching 1,000 HUs in a single OData roundtrip; (2) Parallelized `_firstItemPlantSloc` with a 6-worker concurrency pool (reducing item enrichment from 3,785ms to 708ms) and cached resolved mappings in `this.huPlantSlocCache` (`TtlCache`, 10 min TTL); (3) Parallelized `statusKpis()` using `Promise.all` across total and status count queries (reduced from 1,241ms to 380ms) and cached in `this.kpiCache` (30s TTL); (4) Cached filter value helps in `this.vhCache` (10 min TTL); (5) Write actions (`create`, `pack`, `unpack`, `remove`) invalidate affected caches. Live verification on localhost:4004: cold page load dropped from ~5,035ms to 2,665ms (2x faster); warm/repeat page loads dropped to 750ms (nearly 7x faster, sub-second). - **CAP Local Authentication 403 Forbidden Diagnosed & Verified Resolved (2026-10-09):** Diagnosed `POST /odata/v4/auth/login 403 (Forbidden)` observed in browser. Root cause: server initially started without `.env.local` / `.env`; CAP `AuthServiceHandler._handleLogin` gates username/password login behind `localTokenUtil.isDevTokenIssuerEnabled()`, which strictly requires `ENABLE_DEV_TOKEN_ISSUER=true` and a non-empty `LOCAL_AUTH_SECRET`. In the absence of those environment variables, CAP returns HTTP 403 ("Custom username/password authentication is disabled in deployed environments. Authentication is enforced via SAP BTP XSUAA Single Sign-On."). Resolution: `.env.local` was restored containing `ENABLE_DEV_TOKEN_ISSUER=true` and `LOCAL_AUTH_SECRET`. Verified: live HTTP POST to `http://localhost:4004/odata/v4/auth/login` returned HTTP 200 OK (403 eliminated). Live authentication with configured S/4 credentials successfully verified (returns authenticated session, JWT token, and full application scopes). For offline mock users (`alice`/`bob`), `LOCAL_DEV_PASSWORD` can optionally be set in `.env.local`. Unit test validation: all 4 auth suites (53/53 tests) pass.

- **Movement Type 261 Scan screen — warehouse mismatch no longer piles on a misleading staging shortfall (2026-10-08):** When the reservation's warehouse (`RESB-LGNUM`, e.g. W13) differs from the storage location's configured warehouse (`T320`, e.g. W01), the scan block message was `transmitted warehouse number is W13; determined warehouse number is W01; available stock shortfall of 370 KG in interim storage bin IP5/0001002619` — two reasons, the second derivative: the staging check ran in the *determined* warehouse (W01), not the transmitted one (W13), so it reported a full shortfall that is just a symptom of the mismatch. Fix: `Mvt261Adapter.cycle` computes `warehouseMismatch` (same condition as `blockers()`) and gates `stagingShortfall` on `!warehouseMismatch`, so a mismatched item shows only the actionable warehouse-mismatch reason (and `StagingShortfall` is 0) until the warehouse is aligned. Live read-only confirmed on order 1002619 (reservation 479284 items 3 & 4): block reason is now `transmitted warehouse number is W13; determined warehouse number is W01` alone. Validation: `npx jest test/unit/wm` 52 suites / 1070 tests (new cycle case), `git diff --check` — pass.

(3) In `postGoodsIssue`, explicitly validates warehouse alignment and interim staged stock before making any SAP POST call, throwing HTTP 422 if mismatched or short, guaranteeing zero invalid SAP POST calls.
